title: INC: Embeddings API elevated latency (eu-west-1)
author: Miles Thornton
content:
h1. INC: Embeddings API elevated latency (eu-west-1)

Status: resolved.

h1. Window
2027-03-02 10:20 UTC to 2027-03-02 12:05 UTC.

h1. Impact
Embeddings requests served from eu-west-1 saw p95 latency up to 4x normal. Requests completed; error rates were unchanged. No billing impact.

h1. Resolution
A misconfigured autoscaling floor was corrected. Latency returned to normal by 12:05 UTC.
